name: trion-zk-circuits
description: TRION Protocol BTCP ZK circuit suite — BTCP Master Implementation Spec §14.1 Phase 4 (zk_intent_commitment, zk_complementarity_proof, zk_iap_share_proof, zk_travel_rule, zk_behavioral_credential)

scripts.compile: npm run compile:intent && npm run compile:complementarity && npm run compile:iap && npm run compile:travel && npm run compile:credential
scripts.setup:powersoftau: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 14 pot14_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot14_0000.ptau pot14_0001.ptau --name='TRION contribution 1' -v && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot14_0001.ptau pot14_final.ptau -v
scripts.setup:intent: snarkjs groth16 setup zk_intent_commitment/build/circuit.r1cs pot14_final.ptau zk_intent_commitment/build/circuit_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute zk_intent_commitment/build/circuit_0000.zkey zk_intent_commitment/build/circuit_final.zkey --name='TRION phase2 1' -v && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey zk_intent_commitment/build/circuit_final.zkey zk_intent_commitment/build/verification_key.json
scripts.export:verifiers: for c in zk_intent_commitment zk_complementarity_proof zk_iap_share_proof zk_travel_rule zk_behavioral_credential; do snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier $c/build/circuit_final.zkey $c/verifier.sol; done
scripts.prove:intent: snarkjs groth16 prove zk_intent_commitment/build/circuit_final.zkey zk_intent_commitment/build/witness.wtns zk_intent_commitment/build/proof.json zk_intent_commitment/build/public.json
